justification: Total sample 2000-01-03 to 2026-04-22 ~ 316 months. ECON-OOS2 formula: span = min(max(36, round(316x0.25)), 120) = 79 months. OOS window 2019-10-01 to 2026-04-22. Regime models and IS-quantile thresholds are estimated on in-sample data only; the winner is selected on in-sample data (D9 lead plateau) over the common IS window starting 2006-05-02.
